verdict.rationale: This is a single-skill repository, not a multi-skill collection, so there is no documented way to pick individual skills from a bundle. The `/plugin install logo-design@logo-design-skill` command is Claude Code's own marketplace mechanism, a host-platform capability. Copying the skill folder is a manual user workaround. The lite zip is a size variant of the same skill, not a choice of skills. None of these earns credit.
